subject: Activation assurance: proposed commercial & ops path for renewal
messages:
From: Ethan Miller <ethan.miller@blueorchard.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: April 18th interruptions & renewal timing

Hi Vivek / Marissa,

Quick note from the ops desk — we saw several tail-latency spikes and short connection drops during the April 18 maintenance window. The app recovered automatically, but our on-call had to spin up fallbacks which cost us time and engineering cycles.

We're approaching renewal for our annual commitment in June. Given the interruptions (and the downstream customer complaints), the leadership team is asking whether a reliability path / commercial remediation is available prior to renewal. Specifically:
- Can Redwood commit to a higher uptime SLA (we're looking for 99.95% from the current 99.9%)?
- What short-term credits or “make-good” proposals can we expect for the April incident?
- If we move to a premium SLA tier, what does that mean for lead times and pricing?

Would appreciate a concise proposal that we can take to procurement next week.

Thanks,
Ethan
Ethan Miller
Head of Platform Reliability
Blue Orchard Capital

(Attachment: uptime-incident-summary-brief.txt)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Miller <ethan.miller@blueorchard.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 12:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: April 18th interruptions & renewal timing

Hi Ethan — thanks for flagging this and sharing the summary. I'm sorry for the operational friction; not what we aim for. We ran a preliminary review and can propose a two-part path:

1) Immediate remediation & goodwill: a one-time credit to offset the April incident operational costs (we propose 10% of April invoice) and a technical postmortem we will deliver within 5 business days.

2) Renewal/upgrade path: an optional move to our Premium SLA (target 99.95% uptime) with a 3-month validation pilot (dedicated capacity burst + tighter monitoring) before the anniversary renewal. Pricing delta and exact SLOs below — happy to put in a formal amendment for procurement review.

Proposed next steps:
- I can share a short commercial offer and amendment draft by EOD tomorrow.
- Schedule a 45-minute ops-only technical walkthrough (we'll bring infra and reliability SME).
- Weekly checkpoints during the 3-month validation if you choose premium.

Attaching a short incident checklist and a commercial-offer draft to start.

Best,
Vivek
Head of Revenue, Redwood Inference
(Attachments: uptime-incident-summary-2027-04-18.pdf, commercial-offer-draft.xlsx)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:10:00 -0400
Subject: Fwd: April 18th interruptions & renewal timing

Folks — forwarding Ethan's ask. High-level proposal from Vivek below. Quick notes from commercial:
- Blue Orchard is mid-market but strategically important (cloud wallet + finance vertical).
- Renewal due June 15; procurement wants clear numbers this week if possible.

Suggested commercial framework to close quickly:
- 10% goodwill credit for April (one-off)
- Pilot: 90-day Premium validation at a 50% onboarding discount on incremental premium fee (customer pays only the incremental premium portion).
- If SLA meets thresholds, convert to annual Premium with standard premium pricing.

Can Ops/Infra commit to the pilot config (dedicated capacity burst + 99.95 SLO, weekly checkpoints)? Ben / Grace, can you confirm feasibility and estimated incremental cost?

—Marissa
Director, Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Fwd: April 18th interruptions & renewal timing

Marissa — we can stand up a 90-day dedicated capacity pilot with the following guardrails:
- Dedicated pool sized for Blue Orchard's 95th percentile traffic with 25% burst buffer
- Dedicated monitoring alert SLA and a named on-call escalation path
- Cost estimate: incremental premium delta ~ $15k/mo; with your proposed 50% onboarding discount that's ~$7.5k/mo for the pilot.

I also agree on 10% goodwill credit for April; finance can apply as a one-time bill credit. I'll draft the pilot config and send to legal for amendment language.

—Ben
VP, Solutions & Commercials, Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Miller <ethan.miller@blueorchard.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 15:22:00 -0400
Subject: Proposed offer: Pilot + SLA amendment (summary)

Ethan — following internal alignment here's a concise offer you can present to procurement: 

Offer summary:
- One-time credit: 10% invoice credit for April 2027 applied on next billing cycle (finance to issue).
- Pilot: 90-day Premium Validation Pilot starting as early as May 10. Pilot includes dedicated capacity pool, named on-call, tighter monitoring and 99.95% target uptime SLO for pilot window. Incremental fee: $7.5k/month (pilot discounted).
- Post-pilot: if pilot meets SLOs, we will execute an amendment to convert to annual Premium SLA (99.95%) with standard Premium pricing thereafter.
- Deliverables: 5-business-day postmortem (already in progress), weekly technical checkpoints during pilot, and a shared runbook for incident handling.

Related links / next steps:
- HubSpot deal: https://hub.redwood.ai/deals/BRD-4921
- Draft amendment & pricing sheet (Drive): https://drive.redwood.ai/Shared/blue-orchard-ops-review-2027-04
- Target: sign pilot amendment by 2027-05-05 to allow May 10 start.

If this aligns, we'll route a DocuSign amendment to your procurement and schedule the ops kickoff.

Thanks — Vivek
Head of Revenue, Redwood Inference

> On Tue, Apr 20, 2027 at 08:12 AM Ethan Miller <ethan.miller@blueorchard.com> wrote:
> > Quick note from the ops desk — we saw several tail-latency spikes and short connection drops during the April 18 maintenance window...

(Attachments referenced: uptime-incident-summary-2027-04-18.pdf, commercial-offer-draft.xlsx)

From: Ethan Miller <ethan.miller@blueorchard.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@blueorchard.com
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 18:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Proposed offer: Pilot + SLA amendment (summary)

Vivek — appreciate the clear proposal. Procurement and platform leadership are aligned to the approach. Two quick asks before we sign: 
1) Please add explicit failure credits language to the amendment (example: rolling credits if monthly availability < 99.95; we can provide suggested language).
2) Can you confirm the pilot on-call rotation and SLA runbook will be shared prior to kickoff?

If you can route the DocuSign with those items and a target May 5 sign date, we'll get internal approval and target May 10 kick.

Thanks,
Ethan
Head of Platform Reliability
Blue Orchard Capital

Onward — Ethan
(Attachment: internal-ops-approval-note.pdf)
